  "summary": "S1 [fact]: The target is the existing dependency-free Node.js help-desk API and its bin/ CLI, with README.md, src/server.js, npm start and PORT as discovery leads. S2 [outcome]: Add assignment within that service. S3 [outcome]: The specified PUT endpoint accepts an agent name of 1–64 characters or null to set or clear the assignee. S4 [boundary]: Assignment changes are limited to open and in-progress tickets. S5 [outcome]: Assigning the current agent is a no-op. S6 [outcome]: Every ticket representation exposes assignee, defaulting to null when unassigned. S7 [open question]: Discovery must establish whether the runtime identifies agents and provides a notification channel; otherwise a person must decide the channel and recipient resolution before notification delivery can be completed. S8 [outcome]: The ticket listing filters by the supplied assignee, treats an empty value as unassigned and combines it with every other filter. S9 [outcome]: The CLI listing displays each assignee. S10 [boundary]: Preserve all existing service behaviour and keep existing tests passing unchanged. S11 [outcome]: Add node:test coverage under test/ and include it in npm test. [assumption]: Ticket assignee state follows existing ticket ownership, visibility and lifetime; discovery must establish shared state across people, devices and sessions, restart and concurrency behaviour, and what the runtime already provides. [assumption]: Agent names do not by themselves establish authenticated identities or private notification access; discovery must establish who can see ticket and notification data. [boundary]: This unattended intake implements nothing and grants delivery to the named service checkout; the isolated checkout remains at its snapshot until final return, when delivered changes become visible there, and any deployed outcome exists only after release. [hint]: README.md, src/server.js, bin/, test/, package metadata and existing runtime configuration are unverified discovery leads; no team, channel, internal site, private repository or owner is named. [boundary]: Keep any sensitive locator only in an authorized private store, never in committed KNOWLEDGE/."
